title: Align canonical lifecycle guidance with parallel Work Item governance
rawUserRequest: 查收，全部修复。需要我授权的，授权给你并写入Contract。WI对应途中遇到问题，不要轻易扩展，开新的WI，尽量在当前WI中解决。另外Outcome如果发现没有输出，要调查原因并修复。WI可以并行的，采用并行处理。Outcome按设计，不止是文件还应该是要输出到对话中的。Outcome是通过当前的两个WI对应来观察是否按照需求进行了实现。如果有问题再对应。

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: The English canonical operations lifecycle states that independent Work Items may be active concurrently only when branch, worktree, scope, evidence ownership, and shared projection constraints are compatible.
A2: The Japanese and Simplified Chinese canonical operations pages express the same conditional parallel rule and retain the one-Contract, one-branch, one-PR boundary.

A3: The canonical guidance states that a blocked Work Item does not block an independent compatible Work Item and that orchestration belongs to the Agent/Orchestrator, while governance gates remain fail-closed.
A4: Regression coverage proves the contradictory prohibition is removed and the closed serialized projection inventory and concurrency boundary remain required.

A5: Normal ai-finish emits the Work Item Outcome both to its persisted Outcome artifacts and directly to the conversation; this Work Item records the observed Outcome evidence without changing Outcome generation unless the focused observation finds a defect.
A6: The confirmed governance-complexity policy admits the measured second guarded-parallel Contract field with a bounded repayment record; no unrelated complexity ceiling is changed.

A7: PR aggregate validation accepts a synchronized archived Contract when its synchronizationHistory proves the Start Receipt base advanced to the Contract base, and regression coverage rejects malformed synchronization evidence.

A8: The canonical capability truth matrix and dependent pre-release documentation-alignment projections are regenerated after implementation evidence changes, and the human_benefit_report evidenceSource digest matches the current evidence bytes.
A9: An installed adopter can import ai_check_pr together with ai_capability_truth, and the installer catalog retains both capability-truth runtime dependencies.
guidelines: Canonical documentation is a product behavior contract and must not contradict executable lifecycle behavior.
Describe parallelism as conditional on explicit Work Item ownership and fail-closed shared projection constraints.
Keep one Work Item equal to one Contract, one dedicated branch, and one PR.
Preserve source-language parity across the three canonical operations pages.

intent.problem: The implementation and reference documentation support safe parallel Work Items, but the canonical operations lifecycle still says not to start the next Work Item while the current one is open. That contradiction makes the supported parallel workflow non-authoritative.
constraints: Keep the change limited to canonical operations guidance and regression coverage.
Do not weaken one-Contract/one-branch/one-PR identity, boundary validation, or serialized projection ownership.
Do not mutate the unrelated active Work Item in the user's existing linked checkout.
Treat Outcome as both a persisted artifact and conversation output when observing the two current Work Items.
intent.rationale: Aligning the canonical contract with the already-implemented guarded parallel model removes the false global serialization rule without granting unrestricted concurrency.

declaredIntent.summary: Make the canonical lifecycle guidance accurately describe guarded parallel Work Items.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run boundary and canonical-text regression tests plus the two governed Work Item starts.
